description: This file is a header (.h) file defining interface for HIP9011/TPIC8101 driver, including constants and function declarations related to driver initialization, configuration, and ADC callback.

methods.name: initHip9011
methods.description: Initializes the HIP9011 driver with a shared logger.

methods.name: setHip9011FrankensoPinout
methods.description: Configures the pinout for the HIP9011 on the device.

methods.name: hipAdcCallback
methods.description: Handles ADC input value callbacks, conditionally compiled if HAL_USE_ADC is defined.

methods.name: setHipGain
methods.description: Sets the gain parameter for the HIP9011 device.

methods.name: setHipBand
methods.description: Sets the band parameter for the HIP9011 device.

methods.name: setPrescalerAndSDO
methods.description: Sets the prescaler value and SDO configuration.

methods.name: setMaxKnockSubDeg
methods.description: Sets the maximum knock sub degree value.
